修理装置を所持していると、このアイコンが点灯します。\\n所持ユニットは、ＨＰを.en:
This icon lights up when the unit has a Repair Module.
The unit can use the Repair command, which
restores HP.

補給装置を所持していると、このアイコンが点灯します。\\n所持ユニットは、隣接し.en:
This icon lights up when the unit has a Resupply Module.
The unit can use the Resupply command to fully
restore an adjacent unit's EN and ammo.

単分離を所持していると、このアイコンが点灯します。\\n所持ユニットは撃墜される.en:
This icon lights up when the unit has Separate.
The unit changes form when shot down or via the Separate command.
Once separated, it cannot return to its previous form.

強化パーツ装備数のスロットです。パーツを装備すると点灯します。.en: Part slots. A slot lights up when a Part is equipped.

相手ユニットのパイロットのＳＰを１０減少させます。\\nバリア等でダメージを０に.en:
Reduces the enemy pilot's SP by 10.
No effect if a barrier, etc. reduces the damage to 0.

１ターンの間、相手ユニットの機体の運動性を\\n３０ダウンさせます。\\nバリア.en:
Lowers the enemy unit's Mobility by 30
for 1 turn.
No effect if a barrier, etc. reduces the damage to 0.

相手ユニットのパイロットの気力を５減少させます。\\nバリア等でダメージを０にさ.en:
Reduces the enemy pilot's Morale by 5.
No effect if a barrier, etc. reduces the damage to 0.

１ターンの間、相手ユニットの機体の装甲値を\\n２００ダウンさせます。\\nバリ.en:
Lowers the enemy unit's Armor by 200
for 1 turn.
No effect if a barrier, etc. reduces the damage to 0.

１ターンの間、相手ユニットのパイロットの\\n格闘・射撃・命中・回避・防御・技量.en:
For 1 turn, halves the enemy pilot's
Melee, Ranged, Hit, Evade, Defense and Skill.
No effect if a barrier, etc. reduces the damage to 0.

相手ユニットの機体のＥＮを３０減少させます。\\nバリア等でダメージを０にされた.en:
Reduces the enemy unit's EN by 30.
No effect if a barrier, etc. reduces the damage to 0.

１ターンの間、相手ユニットの機体の照準値を\\n３０ダウンさせます。\\nバリア.en:
Lowers the enemy unit's Accuracy by 30
for 1 turn.
No effect if a barrier, etc. reduces the damage to 0.

１ターンの間、相手ユニットのパイロットの戦闘行動\\n（攻撃、マキシマムブレイク.en:
For 1 turn, the enemy pilot cannot take combat actions
(Attack, Maximum Break, Counter, Support Attack).
No effect if a barrier, etc. reduces the damage to 0.

ダメージを受けた機体に搭乗しているメインパイロットの気力を１０低下させます。\\.en:
Lowers the Morale of the main pilot of the damaged unit by 10.
After battle, if the affected pilot's Morale is 80 or below,
the unit is treated as shot down regardless of its HP.

相手ユニットの持つバリアの効果を無視します。.en: Ignores the enemy unit's barrier effects.

サイズ差補正による与えるダメージの減少を無視します。.en: Ignores size-difference reduction to damage dealt.

前詰めできるチームがありません。.en: There are no teams to move up.

チームを前詰めします。.en: Move teams up to fill empty slots.

チームの前詰めを行います。.en: Move teams up to fill empty slots.

データを引き継ぎ、新たにゲームを始めます。.en: Carry over your data and start a new game.

搭乗できるパイロットがいません。.en: There are no pilots who can board.

ＵＣＷの戦乱を影からコントロールしていた秘密組織『カイメラ』。\\nそのメンバー.en:
$$カイメラ$$: the secret organization that steered the $$ＵＣＷ$$'s wars
from the shadows. The ID badges its members wore were said to amplify
human desire... or maybe not.

破界事変の戦いを駆け抜けた戦士達の闘志を封じたと言われる幻の逸品。\\n破界の王.en:
A fabled item said to hold the fighting spirit of the warriors
of the $$破界事変$$. Some say it is a charm to soothe the rage
and grief of people the $$破界の王$$ made $$次元獣$$s.

再世戦争の末期、人々の世界の再生への願いを封じたと言われる幻の逸品。\\n自らの.en:
A fabled item said to hold people's wishes for the world's rebirth
late in the $$再世戦争$$. Some say it is the feelings of a prince
who risked his life for his people, and of his supporters, given form.

失われし聖王国インサラウムに代々伝わっていた秘宝の一つ。\\nキング・インサラウ.en:
One of the treasured heirlooms of the lost Holy Kingdom of $$インサラウム$$.
Said to be King $$インサラウム$$ I's "love" for his people given form,
it grants its holder great power, but only once.

聖インサラウム王国の次元化学の結晶の一つ。\\n使用者の意志や生命力をキーとして.en:
One fruit of the Holy Kingdom of $$インサラウム$$'s dimensional science.
Keyed to the user's will and life force, it draws $$次元力$$
to power up the weapons of the unit they pilot.

量子演算による統合戦術情報伝達ＡＩシステム。\\n周辺の友軍機は、本システムを装.en:
Quantum-computing AI system for integrated tactical data relay.
Allied units nearby that link to the unit equipped with it
receive precise tactical command.

次元力の応用による万能修理・補給システム。\\n欠損パーツの補修や給弾などに対し.en:
An all-purpose repair/resupply system applying $$次元力$$.
It makes something from nothing to fix lost parts, reload ammo, etc.,
so it can handle every type of machine.

防御行動に特化した自動操縦システム。\\nそのＡＩには、とある星系の非常に臆病な.en:
An autopilot system specialized in defensive actions.
Its AI models a very timid small animal from a certain star system,
and picks the best defense faster than human reflexes.

移動距離に応じて資金が得られる報酬システム。\\n某星系での万歩計の歩数に応じて.en:
A reward system that pays out funds based on distance moved.
It piggybacks on a campaign in some star system that rewards pedometer
step counts, and stops working once that campaign ends.

自分の受けた痛みを相手に味わわせる報復用システム。\\n某星系で多数の機動兵器に.en:
A retaliation system that makes the enemy feel the pain you took.
Fitted to many mobile weapons in some star system, it was hard to use,
and was scrapped after many overdid it and self-destructed. Infamous.

螺旋理論を全ての武装に無理矢理適用させるシステム。\\n螺旋理論の効用については.en:
A system that forcibly applies Spiral Theory to every weapon.
Its effects are still under study, and some researchers claim
the boost is psychological, born of the pilot's love of manly romance.

次元結晶による次元力抽出システム。\\n莫大なエネルギー量を得る事が出来るが、常.en:
A $$次元力$$ extraction system using dimensional crystals.
It yields vast energy, but the constant risk of it running wild
puts an extreme mental strain on the pilot.

極小エリアに次元震を発生させるシステム。\\n周辺の空間を歪ませ、様々な防御機構.en:
A system that creates a dimensional quake in a tiny area.
It warps the surrounding space for use in various defenses, but
some people get symptoms like motion sickness when using it.

亜空間への突入・離脱を応用した移動補助システム。\\n並行世界間の移動ほどのエネ.en:
A movement aid system based on entering and leaving subspace.
A pseudo-warp that needs less energy than parallel-world travel,
it also offers the thrill that you might never make it back.

敵を倒した時に感じる高揚感を増幅させるシステム。\\n脳内の快楽物質の分泌を促進.en:
A system that amplifies the elation felt when defeating an enemy.
It spurs the brain to release pleasure chemicals, so it feels great.
Using it therefore takes strong self-discipline.

パートナーとの絆を強く感じる事が出来るシステム。\\n元々は倦怠期の夫婦の関係改.en:
A system that lets you strongly feel your bond with your partner.
Originally made to mend relations of married couples in a rut, it
was put into use when found to work for any pair of people at all.

人間の生命力そのものから次元力を引き出すシステム。\\nただし、そのためには極限.en:
A system that draws $$次元力$$ from human life force itself.
However, it requires raising Morale to the very limit,
so the user must have matching strength too.

インサラウムの開発したＺＯＮＥを機体に搭載できるサイズに小型化したもの。\\nあ.en:
The $$ＺＯＮＥ$$ developed by $$インサラウム$$, shrunk to fit on a mech.
It taps the $$次元力$$ found everywhere to affect all allies,
but it risks running wild, so it can be used only once per sortie.

次元将ガイオウの身体データから作られた戦闘力強化システム。\\nパイロットの成長.en:
A combat booster built from $$次元将$$ $$ガイオウ$$'s body data.
The mech strengthens as the pilot grows, but past its usage limit,
the pilot is forcibly fused with the mech and meets a terrible end.

次元結晶による次元力抽出システム。\\nエネルギーではなく弾薬の補充に使用される.en:
A $$次元力$$ extraction system using dimensional crystals.
It replenishes ammo rather than energy, but if misused, rounds can
collide inside the magazine and set off a chain explosion.

武器の発射エネルギーを超空間を通過させる事で射程を伸ばすシステム。\\n使用した.en:
A system that extends range by sending weapon fire via hyperspace.
The fire cuts out, then suddenly reappears just short of the target,
which most confuses veteran pilots; improvements are hoped for.

ＡＤＷにおいて戦乱の火付け役とされた、ある特殊部隊の隊員証。\\nＩＤカードとし.en:
The ID of a special unit said to have sparked the wars of the $$ＡＤＷ$$.
Besides serving as ID, it doubled as a fan club card for the unit's
female captain, granting various perks based on combat results.

人間のペルソナを解放するシステム。\\n仮面をかぶる事によって世間体や恥、照れか.en:
A system that releases a person's persona.
Behind the mask, free of appearances, shame and shyness, you can show
your hidden self, but serious people often crash from the backlash.

次元商人が使う古今東西のディメンションジョークを集めたもの。\\n広い範囲の人間.en:
A set of timeless Dimension Jokes used by dimensional merchants.
It can relax a whole crowd at once, but it's only a one-shot gag,
so using it more than once will just make people angry.

全属性のダメージを３０００軽減。\\n気力１３０以上で発動。\\n発動時、ＥＮを.en:
Reduces all-attribute damage by 3000.
Activates at Morale 130+.
Costs 20 EN to activate.

全属性のダメージを１０００軽減。\\n気力１１０以上で発動。\\n発動時、ＥＮを.en:
Reduces all-attribute damage by 1000.
Activates at Morale 110+.
Costs 10 EN to activate.

シモンとダヤッカの気力が１３０以上で、\\nグレンラガンの個別コマンドに「合体」.en:
At Morale 130+ for $$シモン$$ and $$ダヤッカ$$, Combine is added to
$$グレンラガン$$'s unit commands. Selecting it combines $$グレンラガン$$ and
$$超銀河ダイグレン$$ into $$超銀河グレンラガン$$.

相手武器の特殊効果「能力半減」「戦闘不能」「気力低下」\\n「ＳＰ低下」「ＥＮ▼.en:
Nullifies enemy weapon effects Stats Halved, Disabled,
Morale Down, SP Down, EN Down, Mobility Down, Accuracy Down,
Armor Down and Erosion.

気力１３０以上になると搭乗者全員のエレメント能力が\\nヘッド（＝メインパイロッ.en:
At Morale 130+, all boarded pilots' Element abilities
apply to the Head (main pilot).

気力１４０以上で「ジェミニオン・レイ」に変形可能になります。\\nジェミニオン・.en:
At Morale 140+, can transform into $$ジェミニオン・レイ$$.
$$ジェミニオン・レイ$$'s duration has no limit.

気力１２０以上で「ジェニオン・ガイ」に変形可能になります。\\nジェニオン・ガイ.en:
At Morale 120+, can transform into $$ジェニオン・ガイ$$.
$$ジェニオン・ガイ$$'s duration has no limit.

ＺクリスタルのＧＲＡＤＥに応じた個別コマンド「Ｄコマンド」が使用できます。\\n.en:
Enables the unit command D-Command, based on the $$Ｚクリスタル$$'s GRADE.
D-Commands can be used only once per turn,
and each command only once per map.

サテライトキャノン（通常兵器／マップ兵器）が使用可能になります。\\n出撃時のチ.en:
Enables the $$サテライトキャノン$$ (normal weapon / MAP weapon).
It has 1 charge at sortie; firing it drops the charge to 0.
Recharge takes 1 turn on maps with a moon, 2 turns on maps without.

Enables the $$サテライトキャノン$$ (normal weapon / MAP weapon).
It has 1 charge at sortie; firing it drops the charge to 0,
and it recharges after 1 turn.

気力１３０以上で個別コマンド「月光蝶」が使用可能になります。\\n使用すると行動.en:
At Morale 130+, the unit command $$月光蝶$$ is enabled.
Using it ends the unit's action; enemy units within 10 tiles
lose 300 EN, and the unit's own EN is fully restored.

気力１３０以上で全ての武器がバリア貫通になり、\\nクリティカル率＋３０％、与ダ.en:
At Morale 130+, all weapons gain Barrier Pierce,
critical rate +30%, and damage dealt x1.1.

気力１５０以上で「いがみ合う双子」のスフィアが発動し、\\n全ての味方パイロット.en:
At Morale 150+, the Sphere of the $$いがみ合う双子$$
activates: all allied pilots get Skill +10
until the end of the map.

気力１５０以上で「傷だらけの獅子」のスフィアが発動し、\\n全ての味方パイロット.en:
At Morale 150+, the Sphere of the $$傷だらけの獅子$$
activates: all allied pilots get Defense +10
until the end of the map.

気力１５０以上で「悲しみの乙女」のスフィアが発動し、\\n全ての味方パイロットの.en:
At Morale 150+, the Sphere of the $$悲しみの乙女$$
activates: all allied pilots get Evade +10
until the end of the map.

気力１５０以上で「揺れる天秤」のスフィアが発動し、\\n全ての味方パイロットの命.en:
At Morale 150+, the Sphere of the $$揺れる天秤$$
activates: all allied pilots get Hit +10
until the end of the map.

気力１４０以上で「欲深な金牛」のスフィアが発動し、\\nフェイズ開始時に自機から.en:
At Morale 140+, the Sphere of the $$欲深な金牛$$
activates: at phase start, enemy units within 10 tiles
lose 40 EN.

気力１４０以上で「怨嗟の魔蠍」のスフィアが発動し、\\nフェイズ開始時に自機から.en:
At Morale 140+, the Sphere of the $$怨嗟の魔蠍$$
activates: at phase start, enemy units within 10 tiles
suffer Armor Down.

気力１４０以上で「立ち上がる射手」のスフィアが発動し、\\n自機から１０マス以内.en:
At Morale 140+, the Sphere of the $$立ち上がる射手$$
activates: enemy teams within 10 tiles
deal x0.9 damage.

気力１４０以上で「偽りの黒羊」の擬似スフィアが発動し、\\nフェイズ開始時に自機.en:
At Morale 140+, the pseudo-Sphere of the $$偽りの黒羊$$
activates: at phase start, enemy units within 10 tiles
suffer Accuracy Down.

気力１４０以上で「欲深な金牛」の擬似スフィアが発動し、\\nフェイズ開始時に自機.en:
At Morale 140+, the pseudo-Sphere of the $$欲深な金牛$$
activates: at phase start, enemy units within 10 tiles
lose 40 EN.

気力１４０以上で「いがみ合う双子」の擬似スフィアが発動し、\\nフェイズ開始時に.en:
At Morale 140+, the pseudo-Sphere of the $$いがみ合う双子$$
activates: at phase start, enemy units within 10 tiles
lose 3 Morale.

気力１４０以上で「沈黙の巨蟹」の擬似スフィアが発動し、\\nフェイズ開始時に自機.en:
At Morale 140+, the pseudo-Sphere of the $$沈黙の巨蟹$$
activates: at phase start, enemy units within 10 tiles
do not recover SP.

気力１４０以上で「傷だらけの獅子」の擬似スフィアが発動し、\\nフェイズ開始時に.en:
At Morale 140+, the pseudo-Sphere of the $$傷だらけの獅子$$
activates: at phase start, enemy units within 10 tiles
take damage equal to 10% of their current HP.

気力１４０以上で「悲しみの乙女」の擬似スフィアが発動し、\\nフェイズ開始時に自.en:
At Morale 140+, the pseudo-Sphere of the $$悲しみの乙女$$
activates: at phase start, enemy units within 10 tiles
lose 5 SP.

気力１４０以上で「揺れる天秤」の擬似スフィアが発動し、\\n自機から１０マス以内.en:
At Morale 140+, the pseudo-Sphere of the $$揺れる天秤$$
activates: enemy teams within 10 tiles
get Move -3.

uncertain: Part slots / 前詰め: 前詰め rendered 'move teams up (to fill empty slots)'; no prior English found for this command.

Pilot stats in the Stats Halved help: 格闘/射撃/命中/回避/防御/技量 = Melee, Ranged, Hit, Evade, Defense, Skill; mech 照準値 = Accuracy (matches the 'Accuracy Down' effect label), so pilot 命中 = Hit to avoid a clash.
Flavor text of D-Trader parts: several English lines run 63-68 characters (tokens expanded) against Japanese lines of 33-38 characters; may need trimming if the help box clips.
聖インサラウム王国の次元化学 (化学 'chemistry', likely a typo for 科学) rendered 'dimensional science'.
Crest of Rebirth text: 皇子 rendered 'a prince' (Lelouch is implied but not named).
※※未設定１-３ are placeholder strings; rendered '**Not Set 1-3'.

Sphere/pseudo-Sphere lines: 擬似スフィア = 'pseudo-Sphere' (as in rpw_names notes); Sphere names use glossary tokens, so the reused Jigoku line for 沈黙の巨蟹 ('Silent Crab') now differs from the token English 'Taciturn Crab'.
